apps.name: Twitfold: Twitter Bookmarks
apps.desc:
X lets you save posts. It never helped you find them again.

Twitfold turns your X bookmarks into a searchable library on your iPhone. Sync everything once, find any saved post in seconds, and keep a copy even if the original gets deleted.

FIND ANYTHING YOU SAVED
• Full-text search across every bookmark — text, author, link titles and long-form posts
• Filter by author, date or content type
• Reading mode that scrolls like your timeline

ORGANIZE WITHOUT THE WORK
• Folders and tags for any post
• AI Smart Classification: set up your folders once and let AI file new bookmarks
• Batch select, move and tag hundreds of posts at once

KEEP IT, EVEN IF THE ORIGINAL IS GONE
• Bookmarks, your own posts and long-form Articles are stored on your device
• Read offline, including images in saved posts
• iCloud backup & restore for when you switch phones

TAKE YOUR DATA ANYWHERE
• Export to Markdown
